R7 10 kΩ: pad 5 NSS ↔ pad 13 3.3V — REQUIRED (stock plate fits one too)
THE ONE DELIBERATE DEVIATION FROM THE STOCK PLATE
Stock v2.0 ties DIO0 (pad 14) → GPIO 38. This plate LEAVES PAD 14 EMPTY —
GPIO 38 is the only input-capable UART pin on the header, and the GPS gets it.
Safe ONLY because mesh_phy.cpp POLLS (never calls attachInterrupt).
If the Meshtastic PHY is ever made interrupt-driven, this plate breaks.
If you see a wire on pad 14, it is WRONG. Cross-check before power.

g.text: SPI copies NAMES side to side —
Pack dead + phone alive = the phone's driven
pins back-feed the plate through ESD clamps:
the 5 V node at 2.18 V (backwards via the TLV).
An RFM95W runs at 2.5 V — it answered its
version probe, the phone said READY, RX worked,
TX silently impossible. 1 kΩ caps each clamp at
~2 mA, the rail collapses, absence reads honest.

svg.text: RF chain — ANT pad 9 → whip
Coax from pad 9, run ≤ 5 mm:
· CENTER conductor → ANT (pad 9)
· BRAID → GND (pad 10, directly above)
Option a (recommended to start):
u.FL SMT receptacle at pad 9+10, then
Adafruit 851 clips on. Lets you A/B the whip
against the stock plate's known-good FPC antenna.
Option b (final build): cut the 851's u.FL off,
solder center→pad 9, braid→pad 10. One fewer joint.
851 pigtail → panel-mount SMA nut through the cover
→ 915 MHz whip, SMA MALE (not RP-SMA)
NEVER key up with no antenna fitted — it kills the PA.
Make the u.FL CLICK. A resting u.FL is COVEY's
deafness suspect. Strain-relieve at the battery edge.
stock v2.0's R6 in this path is unmeasured — this plate uses plain coax, no series part

BEFORE FIRST POWER — in order
1. Count the plate's terminals against this sheet
(published list matched; physical plate not yet counted)
2. Bench-prove the 5V terminal accepts power IN:
plate off phone, no USB — 5 V supply, 200 mA limit,
onto the 5V pogo pin: phone must show charging.
validates the whole architecture (inferred from the Mega, not measured)
3. Meter the phone's 3.3V pin with the phone OFF —
must be 0 V (the EN gate depends on it), and ON —
must be 3.3 V (ENABLE_DAUGHTER_33V never asserted;
stock plate works, so it should be live).
4. Measure TLV EN open-circuit + its pull-up value;
with R1 4.7k fitted and phone off, EN must sit < 0.4 V.
5. Continuity: pad 14 DIO0 to ANYTHING = must be OPEN.
6. Antenna screwed on BEFORE the first boot.
Polarity double-checks:
JST red = + — verify with a meter anyway;
"off-white or black JST" shells vary (Adafruit's words)
Firmware: READY, dormant (2026-08-20).
After assembly: serial `gps on` (once, persists), then
`gps` — bytes/sentences/fix counters diagnose the bench.
Junction dots mark every real connection; crossings without dots are not connected. Wire colors are nets, not insulation colors — use what you have, but label W# on flag tape.
Print A3 portrait. Sources: HopeRF RFM95W-V2.0 DS (pads), WiPhone Header Breakout doc (terminals), Adafruit 2465/4711 (pads), woods-backplate.md + -bom.md (architecture, 2026-08-11).
